edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Hom. in Cant. II, 7

source_text: Introducite me in domum vini. Foris stetit sponsus et ab sponsa susceptus est; in medio quippe uberum eius requievit. Plurimae iuveneculae non sunt istiusmodi, ut sola introducant; ideo dicitur: Introducite me in domum vini — pluribus loquens. Domus vini ecclesia est, in qua calix Novi Testamenti bibitur. Ordinate caritatem in me: non solum amate, sed ordinate amorem.
pass_a_gloss: Bring me into house of-wine. Outside stood bridegroom and by bride was-received; in midst indeed of-breasts of-her he-rested. Many young-women are-not of-such-sort that alone they-may-bring-in; therefore it-is-said: Bring me into house of-wine — to-many speaking. House of-wine church is in which cup of-New Testament is-drunk. Order love in me: not only love but order love.
pass_b_english: [[Bring me into the house of wine >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:4]]. The Bridegroom stood outside and was received by the Bride; for he rested in the midst of her breasts. Many young women are not of such sort that they alone may bring him in; therefore it is said: Bring me into the house of wine — speaking to many. The house of wine is the church, in which the cup of the New Testament is drunk. Order love in me: not only love, but order love.
notes: Song Homilia II OET; Lawson not used for wording.
